title: Plot residuals against fitted predictions
description: You inspect test errors from an ordinary least-squares model.

steps.question: What does a positive residual mean with this subtraction order?
steps.answer: y_test exceeds the prediction because residuals equals y_test minus y_pred_ols. The model predicted a lower value than the observed target.

steps.description: You scatter predictions horizontally and residuals vertically. The dashed line at zero marks exact prediction agreement.
